delegation.owner_message: A變成成自動化 我不想花太多心力維護
delegation.context: Reply to the question whether new weekly TFDA versions should be checked and published without waiting for the owner; the owner chose automatic publishing to avoid maintenance work.

reviewer_note: Automated checks run by the daily schedule under the owner's delegation; no person or AI reads each weekly version.

TFDA-R1-SOURCE.purpose: The new raw artifact comes from the confirmed TFDA dataset.
checklist: Metadata publisherOID, identifier and license code equal the values confirmed on 2026-09-14.
The ZIP was fetched over HTTPS from a data.fda.gov.tw resource URL discovered from the data.gov.tw metadata.
fetch.json is canonical and its artifact size and SHA-256 match the stored raw ZIP.

TFDA-R1-SCHEMA.purpose: The new version keeps the approved schema and changed by an ordinary weekly amount.
checklist: The ZIP passes the archive limits and the header equals the 34 researched columns in order.
Row count and distinct permit count each changed by at most 10 percent from the serving version.
The blank rate of each key column rose by at most 2 percentage points.
No cancellation status value other than blank, 已註銷 or 已廢止 appears that the serving version did not have.
At least 10 golden cases chosen and parsed by an independent parser pass against the new raw ZIP.
Before the pointer switches, an independent parser compares every curated row with the raw ZIP: row numbers, row hashes, all 34 raw values, classification codes, main category letters and IVD labels.

PUB-R1-OWNER.purpose: A version that passes every automated check may replace the served version on the local MCP runtime.
checklist: Only an installed distribution may publish.
A version that fails any check is not published; the approved version keeps serving and is marked as having a newer candidate.
The owner is emailed after each automatic publish and after each held-back version.
Review records name the reviewer as automated-check:tfda-auto-update, never as a person or as the owner.

golden_cases.selection: Rows matching the fixed coverage list first, then evenly spaced rows until at least 10 cases exist.
golden_cases.comparison: Compare each expected value, row number and row hash with an independent parse of the raw ZIP.
